title: Awareness of electronic crimes in e-learning in Jordan: societal motivation and perspective of the decision model
core_idea: Using a motivation-and-decision model, the study investigates awareness of electronic crimes in Jordan's e-learning environment to understand the motives and decision-making mechanisms (e.g., financial incentives, personal recognition, ideological influences) that lead individuals to engage in unlawful online activities.
tldr: A quantitative study applying a motivation/decision framework to examine motives and decision processes behind electronic crimes in Jordanian e-learning, aiming to improve understanding of emerging threats and inform preventative approaches.
